title: Day: no direct sun on the table, and a darker, more natural day room
author: claude
what: The floor shadows by day ended in a hard straight line. The day room also looked evenly bright, as if the lamps were on, with no darker corners away from the window.
why: The live sun assumed sunlight lands on the table, but the baked floor shows the sun only reaches a strip by the window, so the shadows were cut at the edge of a sun patch that isn't really there. The day bake had the chandelier on (10 bulbs) and a strong hidden ceiling fill light, which flattened the room.
how: By day the live light is now a soft light from the window side with no patch edge, so shadows blend out. For the next day bake the chandelier is off and the hidden fill is cut from 6 W to 1 W (build_room.py), so light falls off naturally into the corners. Needs the day rebake to take effect.
